comment: Read by markdown-link-check via checklist-markdown. That tool does NOT
auto-discover this file; the checklist passes --config explicitly, but
only when the file exists, so deleting it restores the unconfigured
default rather than breaking the hook.
This file is for links no CI can resolve, not for links that are merely
source-tree pages, one per bundled package. Every one of them resolves
with a plain `curl` (200, or 307 to the same page) when checked slowly,
one at a time. markdown-link-check fires all of them in quick
succession and gitlab.alpinelinux.org answers a chunk of that burst
with 418 (a rate-limit / anti-bot response, not a real dead link),
and which links get hit depends on request timing so the failing set
is not even stable between runs. Confirmed by re-running the same
check with the links spaced out: everything resolves.
